name: Positions Detail
description: Retrieves specific details of a traded position. CRITICAL RULE: Can only be used in Repair or Exit conditions where a position already exists.

parameters.name: Detail Type
parameters.description: The specific detail to fetch from the open position.

parameters.name: Transaction Type
parameters.description: Filter by Buy or Sell legs.

parameters.name: Instrument Type
parameters.description: Filter by the type of instrument.

parameters.name: Underlying
parameters.description: The underlying instrument of the position.

parameters.name: Set Number
parameters.description: The Set number (e.g., 1, 2) this position belongs to.

parameters.name: Leg Number
parameters.description: The specific leg number within the position builder.

usage_example: Positions Detail(Detail Type: Entry Price, Transaction Type: All, Instrument Type: All, Underlying: Nifty 50, Set Number: 1, Condition Number: 1, Leg Number: 1)
